title: OpenAI Hires Former Trump AI Official Thomas Lind for National Security Team
summary:
Thomas Lind left the White House’s Office of the National Cyber Director in June and has since taken a position with OpenAI. The former senior official under Donald Trump joined the company's national security team this week to focus on the intersection of intelligence and artificial intelligence.

Lind was a primary architect of the executive order that established the Trump administration's AI framework. His hire moves a key author of federal machine learning policy into the private sector to assist with the development of security initiatives.
